parties.respondent: Dr. Virinderjit Singh Gill (Dead) Thr. Lrs. & ORS

summary: Execution proceedings dispute concerning Khasra No.2259; objections under CPC Order XXI Rule 58 r/w Sections 47 and 151; claim of bona fide ownership via Civil Suit No.107-1 (1989); possession granted via warrant dated 8.9.85; allegations of concealment by decree-holders; service irregularities due to permanent residence change; necessary party status disputed; High Court revision orders (May 6 Sept 16 Nov 20 2015) challenged.
legal_provisions_cited: Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 Order XXI Rule 58
final_judgment: Leave to Appeal granted; High Court orders quashed; execution proceedings to proceed in accordance with law.
